free_tier_only_note: All sounds are free, but Freesound API terms say 'Terms for commercial use of the API will be negotiated on a case by case basis with UPF', ban 'service bureau' use and building 'similar databases', and allow only 'limited intermediate copies'; the site terms say 'you may not use the Freesound website portal for commercial purposes' unless agreed in writing. A paid product that indexes or serves these files needs a written agreement with UPF first (owner action). The CC licence itself lets the files be used in other people's commercial games; CC BY needs a credit for each sound (title, author, link).

human_made_evidence: Freesound has no structured AI-generated field and no AI filter (blog.freesound.org ?p=2082, 2024-06-05; ?p=2417, 2026-07-10, says a filter is not yet built). Uploaders self-report only by tag or description (e.g. tag 'AI-generated' 268 sounds, tag 'ai' 411, 'elevenlabs' 121 and 'suno' 86 text hits; sound 853575 is a self-declared Suno upload). item_count counts only sounds uploaded before 2023-01-01, before public text-to-audio tools, as the date check; newer sounds need a per-sound check of tags, description and uploader before use.
